author: EmuCore - Hub
title: PS2 Emulation on Android is Awesome
summary: An 18-minute Android PS2 overview that sets up and tests both ARMSX2 and NetherSX2, then compares their current strengths instead of declaring one universal winner.

blocks.text: Basement Gamer begins with the state of PS2 play on phones, checks ARMSX2’s official site and small compatibility catalog, and shows why the Google Play installation is convenient. The recording then completes ARMSX2 setup, tests multiple games, installs NetherSX2 Classic and repeats gameplay before a dedicated comparison and conclusion.

The creator notes that ARMSX2 compatibility reporting was still limited at recording time and treats “perfect” labels as prompts to test, not guarantees. NetherSX2 remains a mature comparison point, while ARMSX2’s active development and easier distribution are part of its appeal. BIOS and game acquisition are not provided; viewers need their own lawful dumps and should expect results to change with later builds.
